visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a hotel room entryway featuring a pink suitcase on the wooden floor and a closed dark brown door. Yellow and pink text overlays with a white border appear in the center. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the door handle and safety latch. A hand with neatly trimmed nails enters from the left, holding a small white towel. The hand carefully threads the towel through the loop of the door's security latch and then re-attaches the latch to its wall-mounted hook. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the towel and the metallic sheen of the latch. (3) The camera pans down to the pink suitcase being pushed horizontally against the base of the door. The hand is visible applying pressure to position the luggage securely. The background shows the narrow entrance hallway of a hotel room. (4) A black quilted coat on a hanger is then shown hung over the door handle and the top of the door frame. The camera follows as the door is slightly opened, showing how the items restrict the door's opening angle. (5) The final phase shows a pink circular logo with social media icons and links on a white background, signaling the end of the video.
